capabilities: render grand-staff scores from spartito/score code blocks
compose scores in a visual editor with note and duration pickers
split measures and add bar lines, beaming and key accidentals automatically
save scores as Markdown notes and reopen them in the editor
set default time signature, key, tempo and save folder
extras: Fully offline: the VexFlow library and Bravura music font are compiled into the plugin, so no CDN or network requests are used.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to write or render music notation in notes.

relations.evidence: VexFlow (github.com/vexflow/vexflow) is used for music engraving and is bundled

summary: Music notation renderer and visual editor that draws grand-staff scores from fenced code blocks or a point-and-click editor.
